core_connection.text: Vercel's billing support team. Mia writes to them to dispute charges on her Vercel account and ask for refunds.

evidence.quote: Please refund the duplicate $20.00 charge
refund the October 13 charge as a one-time exception
Hello Vercel Billing Team,
Hello Vercel Billing Team,
Thank you,
Thank you,
I was charged twice for the same Pro plan
Yes, please refund it to the card on file.
I downgraded my team to the Hobby plan

facts.text: In October 2024 Mia was charged twice ($20.00 each, posted October 7, 2024) for the same Pro plan period, October 7 to November 6, 2024.

evidence.quote: I was charged twice for the same Pro plan billing period
both cover October 7 to November 6, 2024

facts.text: Mia's Vercel account had only one team and one seat.

evidence.quote: My account has only one team and one seat

facts.text: Mia asked for the duplicate 2024 charge to go back to the card on file.

evidence.quote: Yes, please refund it to the card on file.

facts.text: Mia downgraded her team to the Hobby plan on September 20, 2025.

evidence.quote: I downgraded my team to the Hobby plan on September 20, 2025

facts.text: On October 13, 2025 Mia was still charged $20.00 for the Web Analytics Plus and Speed Insights add-ons after the downgrade. She has not deployed any project since the downgrade.

evidence.quote: Web Analytics Plus and Speed Insights
I have not deployed any project since the downgrade

facts.text: Mia asked for both add-ons to be removed and for the October 2025 charge to be refunded as a one-time exception, back to the original payment method.

evidence.quote: Please remove both add-ons
Yes, the original payment method is fine.

facts.text: Mia's complaint emails always end by asking for written confirmation of the refund amount and that no further or duplicate charges will be made.

evidence.quote: Please confirm the amount being refunded
that no further charges will be made

facts.text: When billing asks a confirmation question, Mia replies in one short sentence with no greeting or sign-off.

evidence.quote: Yes, please refund it to the card on file.
Yes, the original payment method is fine.
